MedicalJobsAustralia.com     About us 

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementiacareand palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs,backgroundor financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinicalexpertise. 

When it comes to our people - those we serve and those who serve - we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality,religionand ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We'vebeen caring for people for over 90 years - so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It'snot just care,it'sHammondCare.

Aboutthe role

The Cloud Systems Engineer is responsible for managing, supporting, and improving HammondCare's cloud and server infrastructure, ensuring secure,reliable, and efficient technology services across the organisation.

Responsibilities

Design, manage, and optimise hybrid cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and on-premises environments.

Administer and support Windows Server, Active Directory-Entra ID, virtualisation platforms, and core infrastructure services. 

Manage Azure resources, identity services, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery solutions. 

Provide Level 3 technical support, troubleshooting complex infrastructure and cloud-related issues. 

Lead and execute infrastructure upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, and modernisation projects. 

Maintain security, patching, vulnerability management, compliance, and operational standards. 

Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, capacity, and resilience to ensure reliable service delivery. 

Manage enterprise file, print, SharePoint, backup, and business continuity services.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and architecture artefacts. 

Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and service providers while supporting change, incident, and problem management processes. 

Drive cloud governance, cost optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Participate in after-hours support and on-call activities for critical incidents. 

What we can offer you

We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including: 

NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free)

Additionalleave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave

Flexible working options, including hybrid arrangements

Discounts on everyday products and services

Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families

Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families

Health & Wellbeing programmes

Reward & Recognition programmes

Referral bonuses

Career and professional development opportunities

What we are looking for

Commitment to HammondCare's Christian Mission and values. 

Bachelor's degree in information technology (or related field), or equivalent practical experience. 

3-5 years' experience in a Cloud Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or similar role. 

Experience designing and supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, and technology solutions. 

Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, hybrid cloud infrastructure, Windows Server, virtualisation (VMware-Hyper-V), and Microsoft 365. 

Experience managing identity, security, networking, SharePoint, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. 

Strong skills in infrastructure security, patching, vulnerability management, automation (PowerShell-Python), and troubleshooting. 

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, customer service, and project delivery capabilities. 

Ability to work independently, collaborate effectively, and provide on-call-after-hours support when required. 

Certification in Microsoft or equivalent (MCSE, Azure-AWS) desirable

ITILcertification desirable

IT securityexperience desirable

To Apply

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now! For any specific queries please contacttalent@hammond.com.au.

Pre- Employment Checks 

All short-listed applicants for these positions will be asked to consent to a criminal record check and reference checks.

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves.    Click here to Apply now →

Lead architecture across a major insurance transformation shaping future business and technology capabilities.   Your new company     We're seeking an experienced Insurance Domain Architect to play a pivotal role in defining the future-state architecture across core insurance operations, data, reporting and business capabilities. This is a unique opportunity for an architect who combines deep insurance industry expertise with strong enterprise architecture capability and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders across multiple organisations.    Your new role     As the Insurance Domain Architect, you'll act as the architectural authority across insurance operations, ensuring business, regulatory and operational requirements are reflected in strategic technology decisions. Working closely with business leaders, architects, delivery partners and external stakeholders, you'll define target-state and transition architectures, drive governance outcomes and provide architectural leadership across a complex transformation environment. This role sits at the intersection of business and technology, making it ideal for an architect who enjoys influencing strategy, operating models, transformation roadmaps and enterprise-wide decision-making.   
 
 Define and maintain target-state and transition-state architectures across core insurance domains. 
 Provide architectural leadership across claims, policy administration, billing, underwriting support and related business functions. 
 Partner with business, finance, compliance and technology stakeholders to ensure architecture decisions support organisational objectives. 
 Lead architecture governance, decision-making forums and design reviews. 
 Translate complex business, regulatory and technical requirements into practical architectural outcomes. 
 Develop architecture artefacts, standards, roadmaps and governance documentation. 
 Ensure alignment across business, data, integration and technology architecture domains. 
 Identify and mitigate architecture, regulatory and delivery risks. 
 Support data and reporting initiatives where insurance business rules drive platform and reporting requirements. 
 Present and defend architecture decisions to senior technical and executive stakeholders. 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Extensive experience as a Domain Architect, Enterprise Architect, Business Architect or senior Solution Architect within insurance.   
 Strong knowledge of claims, policy administration, billing and underwriting processes.   
 Experience working closely with finance, actuarial, risk and compliance functions.   
 Demonstrated experience developing enterprise architecture roadmaps, target-state architectures and transformation strategies.   
 Strong knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.   
 Experience operating within structured governance and assurance environments.   
 Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence executive and technical audiences alike.   
 Experience working across multi-vendor, partner or enterprise transformation programs.   
 Exposure to core insurance platforms such as Duck Creek, Guidewire, Sapiens, Majesco or similar would be highly regarded.   What you'll get in return     
 Influence strategic decisions that will shape future business capabilities. 
 Competitive contract opportunity with flexible hybrid working arrangements. 
 Join a highly visible program delivering meaningful organisational change 
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
